limitations: One trained seed, eight disjoint regions of one corpus; not corpus or seed uncertainty.
Target bytes are the same across all context arms; do not count repeated scoring as new data.
Continuous stream prefixes can cross original document boundaries.
640000 training-byte exposure is not established convergence.
First 32 target bytes reduce averaging dilution but are only 256 scored bytes over eight regions.
Frozen real-word completion is now measured; live metrics are recovered logged means, not a new learning experiment.
